caption: The drawing contains three stylized birds, each composed of bold, flat areas of color with minimal shading. The top bird is primarily red with green spots on its wings, a green head, a red beak, and a black eye. Its legs and feet are also green, and it has a yellow accent on its wing. The middle bird has a green head, red beak, and a predominantly yellow body with brown and red detailing, while the wing features a white section outlined in green that is segmented to resemble scales. Its legs and feet are red. The bottom bird has a green head, red beak, a red and green patterned body with a large white oval on its side containing yellow shapes, and a fan-shaped tail in red and yellow. Its legs and feet are yellow. All birds are drawn against a light brown, slightly textured background. There is black text near the bottom identifying the inspiration as "FROM WOOD CARVING AND BIRTH CERTIFICATES 1782 to 1819," with additional publication information along the lower edge.
title: Plate 10: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
